section_title: Power supply, installation and testing of I&C equipment
text: I&C cabinets shall be installed in air-conditioned rooms (N+1 cooling, positive pressure, filtered air per ER-10.06), separated by function (DCS, SIS, TCS, CEMS) with the SIS in separate cabinets; cable entry from below with the fire and gas sealing; cabinet heat dissipation and temperature rise are part of the room HVAC design.
